model_output.rationale: DOS 2025-01-19, commercial CI. Both lines CO-29/N211. The 277CA shows A2 acceptance 2025-01-27 — only 8 days post-DOS, inside any commercial window — which is the strongest form of timely-filing proof. N211 is a Medicare-FFS marker; Liberty Bell is a commercial CI payer with no statutory authority to bar appeal. The exception to write-off exists: an accepted-in-window clearinghouse report.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 both lines; 837P envelope dated 2025-10-15 (~269 days post-DOS). However 277CA (A2, received 2025-01-27) proves a timely-accepted submission 8 days post-DOS — the payer's receipt date is disputable.

next_action.detail: Appeal both CO-29 lines to Liberty Bell citing 277CA ACK75364521 (A2 accepted for adjudication, received 2025-01-27) as proof of timely receipt. N211 is Medicare-specific and does not bar commercial appeal. Do not bill patient — group code CO.

evidence.fact: Both lines 97110-GP and 97140-GP denied CO-29 ($138.62 total); MOA N211; filing indicator CI (commercial, not Medicare FFS).
A2 (accepted for adjudication), status code 20, received date 2025-01-27 — 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19; trace TRC75364521.
837P transmission envelope dated 2025-10-15; same trace TRC75364521 — later than 277CA, indicating resubmission after an earlier timely-filed original.

03-timely-filing.md: 'clearinghouse/payer acceptance report (strongest)' proof; remedy is appeal disputing receipt date. 00-group-codes.md: CO-29 write-off only 'with no exception' — the 277CA A2 is the exception.
evidence.locator: 03-timely-filing.md §8 Proof accepted row; 00-group-codes.md next_action ladder final row

citations.rule: Proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report: dispute the receipt date, don't plead forgiveness.
CO with no appeal basis or rights exhausted; CARC 29 with no exception → do_not_resubmit. Exception present here: 277CA A2 acceptance.
CARC 29: filing limit expired; N211 is the Medicare FFS pairing — inapplicable to CI commercial payer.
